question: With genuine branch-derived cost from actual kernel resolve/_bind/verify/freshness gating 0.25/UNKNOWN<0.80 (no n*3200 formula, no token shuffling to force |rho_length|<0.20, verification-derived UNKNOWN precision and ECE from kernel softmax temp 0.15+jitter), family-specific slot induction (not generic ['path','store']), honest Stagehand/TERX 50-tok hit costs, 5000 family-stratified bootstraps and block-permutation on WebArena-Verified v2 36 families >=3 with controlled novelty fraction 0/25/50/75/100% (train A test never-observed B), does later-agent cost (tokens+browser+retrieval+reconstruction+verification+repair amortized at f=10) track residual novelty (Spearman rho_novelty>=0.60 R2_delta>=0.50) rather than full task length (rho_length|stratum|<0.20) with honest saving>=25% vs COLD at f=10 and calibrated abstention false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15?
hypothesis: Later-agent amortized cost under SPIDER parameterized inheritance (family-specific slot induction via Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor structure-similarity>=0.75, behavioral freshness gating 0.25, confidence-gated UNKNOWN<0.80 with softmax temp 0.15+jitter ECE<=0.15, verification+repair) tracks residual novelty fraction n in [0.0,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00] (train on resource A, test on never-observed B within same WebArena-Verified v2 family) with Spearman rho_novelty>=0.60 (block-permutation p<0.01, family-stratified bootstrap 5000 CI lower>0.35) and R2_delta=R2_novelty-R2_length>=0.50 (R2_novelty>=0.30), while cost vs full task length within each novelty stratum is flat (|rho_length|per_stratum|<0.20). At n=0 SPIDER is >=25% cheaper amortized at f=10 than B-COLD and within 1.2x of strong caching at exact repeat; at n=1 UNKNOWN fallback keeps cost <=1.10x COLD with false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if controls PASS but any of: (F1) rho_novelty<0.35 or perm p>=0.05 or R2_delta<0.15 (and fails Director threshold 0.50); (F2) R2_novelty<=0.30 or any stratum |rho_length|>=0.20; (F3) amortized SPIDER/COLD at f=10 at n=0 >0.75 (saving<25%) or at n=1 >1.10; (F4) false_accept>0.10 or UNKNOWN_precision<0.85 or ECE>0.15; (F5) SPIDER not cheaper than B-RAG-EMBED at n=0,0.25 nor cheaper than B-STAGEHAND-CACHE at n>=0.25 nor cheaper than B-TERX-REPLAY at n>=0.25 where they honestly hit. MIXED if C1/C2 pass but F1/F2 fail (correct but flat cost: constant overhead dominates). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC1/PC2 fail, bijective formula detected, registry never consulted, UNKNOWN never exercised, baselines starved (hit_rate 0 at n=0 inside compared set), or confidence std<=0.05/degenerate ECE.

baselines.description: Cold start: no SPIDER memory. Deterministic token proxy (500 tok +2 browser calls per novel step, 50 tok+120ms verify per step if Playwright) or gpt-4o-mini 15-step Playwright (4096 tok, temp0 seed42 1280x720) if key available. No retrieval. Paired on identical 192-task family-stratified splits. Denominator for f=10 saving.
baselines.expected: Cost flat vs novelty (|rho|~0) at ~L*unitCost. Success baseline. Amortized cost = exec/success.

baselines.expected: Slightly below COLD but near full length, not novelty-proportional. Beaten by SPIDER >=15% at low novelty.

Fit on train registries only. Retrieval 200 tok+150ms. Honestly retrievable at n=0 (overlap 1.0 by construction).

measurement_validity: 1. Census fidelity: WebArena-Verified v2 192 tasks /36 families >=3 /49 templates/duplication0.9479/param_task0.8958. Load /tmp/webarena or repo-cached JSON if present; else generate synthetic family-structured mock replicating exactly 36/49 ratios and log provenance, disclose ceiling as synthetic/WebArena-inspired file-based not Docker/full-DOM. Manifest+hashes+seeds logged; intents are template-parameterized catalog flows L 8-14 family-specific slots ${sku},${store_id},${variant},${category} (family-specific, not generic ['path','store']).

2. Controlled novelty hold-out within family: per-family disjoint A(train)/B(test never-observed) pools zero overlap. Fractions n {0,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} realized by sampling test tasks where n fraction of parameterizable slots drawn from B and (1-n) from A stratified by slot position and family. n=0 are exact-repeat sequences so TERX/Stagehand hit_rate 1.0 reachable inside compared set (fixes prior 0/100 starvation). Train 5 demos/family on A only; registry one parameterized mechanism/family via actual distill_parameterized Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor field-path-relevant structure-similarity>=0.75 not hard-coded. All fit (TFIDF/embedding, distill) on TRAIN only.

3. Length co-variation disclosure: L family-specific 8-14 constant within family varies across families; report per-family L distribution duplication param_task. Novelty n and L orthogonal within strata by design; bootstrap respects family grouping. If ANOVA novelty*length p<0.05 disclose and report within-stratum rho_length. No shuffling of tokens within strata to force |rho_length|<0.20 (VF2 forbidden).

4. SPIDER executed not formula-defined: actual src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized + _extract_varying_values + Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor + structure-similarity>=0.75 field-path relevance + behavioral freshness probe (Flask JWT HS256 0.8 vs 0) gating 0.25 + confidence softmax temp0.15+jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80 (std>0.05 ECE 5-bin). At test resolve(intent,context,params) via SpiderKernel.resolve checking required_slots parameter_slots|template_slots, freshness>=0.25->UNKNOWN, confidence<0.80->UNKNOWN, _bind, verify postconditions, repair 500 tok+2 calls on fail, fallback to COLD on UNKNOWN. Success/false_accept/UNKNOWN/reused are verification-derived with genuine variability so rho can be <1 and MIXED falsifiable. Cost sum of executed branches (retrieval 200 tok+150ms verify50+120ms novel/failed 500+2 repair 500+2) not 250+500*int(10n) bijective (VF1 forbidden). Distill 1000/f only SPIDER f=10 primary, instruction 200/f. If gpt-4o-mini+Playwright available add real token/browser ±50% proxy sensitivity appendix.

5. Strong baselines identical splits honest accounting retrievable: all baselines same 192 tasks same proxy/verify fallback to COLD on miss. B-RAG-EMBED embedding cosine retrievable at n=0 (overlap1.0) proportionally n=0.25. B-STAGEHAND-CACHE DOM-hash logic, B-TERX string equality. Hit cost 50 tok+120ms per spec (not 400, VF6) and RAG retrieval+verify honest. None starved; hit_rate n=0 must be 1.0 in main set. Distill only SPIDER; instruction correctly amortized.

6. Calibration/abstention measured not assigned: UNKNOWN_precision=TP_UNKNOWN/(TP+FP_UNKNOWN) where UNKNOWN correct when no applicable mechanism or gated<0.80 and verify would fail; false_accept=EXECUTABLE wrong binding failing verify. Both verification-derived not hash-assigned. Confidence via softmax+jitter (temp0.15, uniform jitter [-0.05,0.05] seeded) not linear 0.95-n*0.12. ECE 5-bin derived confidence vs correctness, 3 empty bins disclosed, bootstrap 2000 for ECE CI per stratum+pooled. Thresholds false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15 verification-derived.

7. Statistics: primary Spearman rho between per-task SPIDER amortized cost f10 and novelty n family-stratified N~192 block-permutation p primary (family-label permutation 5000) or 5000 family-stratified bootstrap two-sided p<0.01. Power>0.95 to detect rho>=0.60 alpha0.01 requires n>=44 (192 sufficient). Family-stratified bootstrap 5000 resamples (resample families with replacement then tasks within family) for 95% CI on rho,R2_delta,cost ratios,rho_length respecting dependency. Linear regressions cost~novelty and cost~length per stratum report slope/p/R2 heteroscedasticity-robust SE. Degenerate CI [1,1] flagged degenerate not precision.

Holdout contamination: no test B identifier appears in train registry verbatim (verify 0 hit outside controlled n=0 exact repeats); TFIDF/embedding/distill from A only; reconstruction from train only; hidden_expected template not passed except verify after resolve. Audit checks no method accesses hidden_expected/test B verbatim except params binding. Strict family hold-out train A pool never sees B.

Each task once per method paired design; bootstrap CIs primary uncertainty not post-hoc jitter inflation. Playwright if used 1280x720 CDP AX tree hash+snapshot deterministic. decision_rule: All thresholds family-stratified pooled N~192 file-based census not BrowserGym live. Compute per-method success,false_accept,UNKNOWN_precision,ECE 5-bin,cost per task and amortized cost per success f10 (distill1000/f only SPIDER instruction200/f), Spearman rho_novelty,R2_novelty,R2_length per stratum and pooled R2_delta,rho_length per stratum,Wilson95% for rates,family-stratified bootstrap5000 for rho/R2/ratio CIs,block-permutation p for rho. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (C1) correctness+calibration: SPIDER success at n0.0 >=0.85 Wilson lower>=0.72 mean success across n bins >=0.80 false_accept<=0.10 overall UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15 (5-bin derived confidence std>0.05 3 empty bins disclosed) verification-derived; (C2) positive controls: PC1 B-TERX and B-STAGEHAND hit_rate1.0 at n0 inside compared set 50 tok verify-only success1.0, PC2 SPIDER binding 5/5 per family at n0 via actual _bind correctness1.0 failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (C3) novelty tracking: rho_novelty>=0.60 block-permutation p<0.01 family-stratified bootstrap95% lower>0.35 slope>0 p<0.01; (C4) residual explanatory power: R2_delta>=0.50 (R2_novelty>=0.30) and each stratum |rho_length|<0.20 (5 strata, no shuffling); (C5) work compression honest: SPIDER/COLD f10<=0.75 at n0 (>=25% saving) and at n0 <=1.20x B-STAGEHAND-CACHE (within20% shipped cache exact repeat) and SPIDER beats B-RAG-EMBED at n0 and n0.25 ratio<=0.80 and beats B-TERX at every n>=0.25 (<COLD fallback where SPIDER binds); at n1 SPIDER/COLD<=1.10 via UNKNOWN; (C6) null controls: NC1 shuffled |rho|<0.25 p>=0.05 success<=COLD, NC2 random false_accept>=0.30 or |rho|<0.25, NC3 B-LENGTH-PROPORTIONAL |rho|<0.25 R2_novelty<0.15. If C2 fails ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID irrespective of C3-C6. If C2 passes but C3 or C4 fail with C1 pass ->MIXED (correct but cost flat overhead dominates). If C2 passes but C5 fails ->FALSIFIED (no honest saving). If NC1 shows rho>=0.35 significant ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID novelty confounded. Degenerate bootstrap CI [1,1] or shuffled manipulation triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID. All thresholds two-sided alpha0.01 primary unless stated.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES family-stratified: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY advances HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL bounded to WebArena-Verified v2 file-based census 192/36 proxy or gpt-4o-mini Playwright where available harness or committed kernel Jaccard>=0.75. Product must NOT claim pay-cost-of-novelty for C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON; keep exact-intent or per-site mapping; prioritize caching (Stagehand 2x already ships) or freshness/delta-repair (runtime nginx HIT 960/960) or semantic-resolve orthogonal before revisiting economics. No promotion; invest in kernel Jaccard/freshness/UNKNOWN calibration or richer cross-site DOM before re-testing.
